words.gloss: he whose nature is the pursuit of wealth

literal: Thinking of the husband whose nature is the pursuit of wealth, in this bewildering evening, my un-perishing life perishes.
translation: Thinking of my beloved whose sole pursuit is wealth, my otherwise un-perishing life now perishes in this bewildering evening.
modern: பொருளையே இயல்பாகக் கொண்ட என் தலைவரை நினைத்து, இந்த மயக்கத்தைத் தரும் மாலைப் பொழுதில், அழியாத என் உயிர் அழிகின்றது.
explanation: The heroine laments her state of separation as twilight falls. She thinks of her husband, who has left her to pursue wealth, describing him as one whose nature is bound to wealth. As she remembers him, the bewildering and sorrowful evening hour overcomes her. Her life, which had stubbornly survived the pain of separation until now, finally begins to fade away under the weight of this evening grief.
